QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Magician
QuestInfo.0: What does it mean to be a Magician? Talk to #p1002101# in Lith Harbor.
QuestInfo.1: #p1002101# in Lith Harbor says you can choose to become a #bMagician#k if you're at least #bLevel 8#k. He tells you to see #rGrendel the Really Old#k in #rEllinia#k. If you'd like to walk there, check your World Map. (#rW#k)
QuestInfo.2: You learned what it takes to be a true Magician from the chief of all wizards, Grendel the Really Old. You have a feeling this is the right path for you.

0.0: #b#p1032001##k, the greatest Magician... I have never seen him up close. Someone told me he's always at the Magic Library, reading. So do you want to become a Magician?

yes.0: Okay. Give #b#p1032001##k my greetings. Perhaps I'll get to meet him one day. Anyway, to become a Magician, head to Ellinia and go to the Magic Library.

no.0: You don't think being a Magician suits you? Seems all right to me... In any case, talk to me when you're ready to choose a path.

1.0: Are you here to become a Magician like me?

yes.0: Many come, hoping to be great Magicians. They push themselves hard. If you wish to join them, you need to be at least #bLevel 8#k. Talk to me when you're ready.

npc.0: At the very top of the biggest tree in the biggest forest of Victoria Island, a place called #bEllinia#k, you'll find #b#p1032001##k.
